findings.finding: Child a256 (the monolithic demo-retirement story) is in direct scope-overlap with the entire demo-retirement slice set (1969, ce4f, 43bd, f7bd, 1461, 18e8, 8c31, d4ca, d0af, 9b96, 742d): it plans the SAME deletions (operations._review_ticket_impl, review_workflows.py, ticket-quality eval spec + solver branch, ticket_quality.md prompt, aggregate.py, the repoints) that those siblings each own.
